answer: Before a signing agent may notarize a payout, the state commissioning office checks the notary commission number and seal serial against its registry and against the journal kept for every act. A seal serial that appears in two journals trips a commissioning audit, voids the certificate and calls the surety bond. A commission costs 85, the bond 40 and the journal 22, so N fakes cost N x 147 and each still needs an in person oath in front of a live witness, while a zenith decal on the desk, a tundra photo on the wall and a dune poster add nothing to the registry.
